name: default
description: Card list (控え室) as of 2026-09, measured on 2000x923 screenshots where a card is 130x130px: art flush with the left edge, ~5px rarity frame top/right/bottom, attribute icon top-left, stars + master rank badge over the lower art, dark 'Lv.xx' bar spanning the card width 5px above the bottom. card_to_art assumes the square art continues under the bar; refine it with `sekai-card-id calibrate`.
